purpose: Two sectional-perspective concepts of one oval interior. Concept only, no CAD changes.
shared_spatial_brief: One consistent near-future reclaimed ruin, an oval recessed atrium under the existing raised oval rooftop plinth. Native measured outer oval 168.0 x 111.6 m; host roof Z=63.0 m; oval rim Z=72.6 m; existing middle road Z=35.0 m. Ellipse long axis E-W. Roof oculus proposed 110x66m within the oval. Entrance via one broad 8m-wide curved external stair on the roof, climbing 9.6m from 63 to72.6 on the south/southeast side, then a deliberate 2.8m drop to first interior landing Z69.8 (no staircase bypass). Three discontinuous curved gallery sequences around a large empty vertical atrium, with elegant short helicoidal stair flights and level side bays: tier1 starts69.8 and stair/walk descends to60.6; gap/drop at60.6 down to tier2 at57.8; tier2 short spiraling stair descends to48.6; gap/drop at48.6 down to tier3 at45.8; final short spiraling stair toZ35.0 and horizontal exit. Platforms 8-12m wide, empty 14-22m side bays for later unspecified content. Gallery arcs are partial crescents, rotated between tiers, not complete floor discs, and not one unbroken spiral ramp. Drops land on broad safe lower terraces directly below with a small horizontal inset, not over bottomless pits. Real game jump apex ~1.1m means the 2.8m ledges are one-way, but no tall props alongside them form a staircase back up. Show route with thin cyan/orange arrows, visibly interrupt arrows at drops. Middle-road exit is northwest side, outside the ellipse via a short approx26m level connector tunnel atZ35, joins the existing black road side shoulder, does not route to sea, bottom promenade or under the road. Measured nearest road edge native(1025.99,369.77,35), ellipse center(1086.01,302.52). Keep selected saddle grid-shell pavilion separate on roof in background. No shrine/statues/no pedestals with NPCs. Smooth lightweight ivory precast curved slabs, slender warm weathered metal ribs, bluegrey glass fragments, restrained near-future panel joints and small patchy vegetation creeping in from daylight; bright stylized painterly architectural concept, not dark realistic dungeon, not medieval ruin. This is a concept only; preserve the existing map geometry until modeling is authorized.

Remove the tall central waterfall, all vertical water streaks, the bottom pool and mist. Replace those water effects with a clear sunlit empty air void and a warm ivory dry floor at the bottom, exposing the already-existing slender structural ribs and circulation. Keep all existing architectural geometry, all stair flights, gallery positions, external stair, roof oculus, structural cut edges, road and exit, all human silhouettes, route arrows, title and level annotations exactly unchanged. Retain sparse small plants only along building edges. No fountain, water feature, pond, fog or replacement sculpture. Maintain the same camera and painterly architectural rendering, same image layout, same proportions.
